csv_project_name: Conslt for Greenville Thoroughfare & Transpotation Plan
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Greenville, South Carolina (the City ), is requesting proposals for City of Greenville Thoroughfare Plan. The City is requesting technical proposals for turn-key engineering services for the planning and preparation of a final report for the project. The consultant may develop their own detailed approach to the project, however, the following framework is offered to provide guidance and understanding of the City s expectations. The qualified consultant shall demonstrate experience and qualifications with transportation planning, road design, traffic engineering, structural design, environmental permitting, utility coordination, and the preparation of planning documents.
